content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler cereal is a whole‑grain infant cereal designed for children from 6 months old. It contains easily digestible grains, vitamins and minerals essential for growth and development. The cereal is free from artificial colours, flavours and gluten.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Made from whole oats and rice grains.
Includes pre‑biotics that support a healthy gut microbiome.
Product undergoes strict quality control and meets international infant‑food safety standards.
Packaging is made from recyclable material, reducing environmental impact.
Each serving provides a balanced ratio of carbohydrates, protein and fat.

items.title: Supports bone growth
items.content: Enriched with calcium and vitamin D, which help build strong bones.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: B‑vitamins and iron aid nervous system development and cognitive function.

items.title: Digestive health
items.content: Pre‑biotics and soluble fibre promote regular bowel movements and gut health.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamin C and zinc contribute to a robust immune system.

items.title: Energy provision
items.content: Complex carbohydrates provide sustained energy for active toddlers.

items.title: Grain allergy
items.content: Children with known oat, rice or other grain allergies should consult a pediatrician before use.

items.title: Over‑consumption
items.content: The cereal is calorie‑dense; follow the recommended serving size to avoid excess intake.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: For infants under 6 months, the cereal may be too thick; thin it to a smooth consistency.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Prepare the cereal with warm water or breast milk to the desired consistency. You can add fruit or vegetable puree for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, use within 30 days and keep the bag tightly sealed.
